Operations.Name: GetTrailers
Operations.Description: Finds movies and trailers similar to a given trailer.

Options.Name: userId
Options.Description: The user id supplied as query parameter; this is required when not using an API key.

Options.Name: maxOfficialRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).

Options.Name: hasThemeSong
Options.Description: Optional filter by items with theme songs.

Options.Name: hasThemeVideo
Options.Description: Optional filter by items with theme videos.

Options.Name: hasSubtitles
Options.Description: Optional filter by items with subtitles.

Options.Name: hasSpecialFeature
Options.Description: Optional filter by items with special features.

Options.Name: hasTrailer
Options.Description: Optional filter by items with trailers.

Options.Name: adjacentTo
Options.Description: Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.

Options.Name: parentIndexNumber
Options.Description: Optional filter by parent index number.

Options.Name: hasParentalRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.

Options.Name: isHd
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are HD or not.

Options.Name: is4K
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.

Options.Name: locationTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: excludeLocationTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: isMissing
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.

Options.Name: isUnaired
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.

Options.Name: minCommunityRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by minimum community rating.

Options.Name: minCriticRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by minimum critic rating.

Options.Name: minPremiereDate
Options.Description: Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.

Options.Name: minDateLastSaved
Options.Description: Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.

Options.Name: minDateLastSavedForUser
Options.Description: Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.

Options.Name: maxPremiereDate
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.

Options.Name: hasOverview
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.

Options.Name: hasImdbId
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that have an IMDb id or not.

Options.Name: hasTmdbId
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that have a TMDb id or not.

Options.Name: hasTvdbId
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that have a TVDb id or not.

Options.Name: isMovie
Options.Description: Optional filter for live tv movies.

Options.Name: isSeries
Options.Description: Optional filter for live tv series.

Options.Name: isNews
Options.Description: Optional filter for live tv news.

Options.Name: isKids
Options.Description: Optional filter for live tv kids.

Options.Name: isSports
Options.Description: Optional filter for live tv sports.

Options.Name: excludeItemIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by excluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: startIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.

Options.Name: limit
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum number of records to return.

Options.Name: recursive
Options.Description: When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.

Options.Name: searchTerm
Options.Description: Optional. Filter based on a search term.

Options.Name: sortOrder
Options.Description: Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.

Options.Name: parentId
Options.Description: Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.

Options.Name: fields
Options.Description: Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.

Options.Name: excludeItemTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: filters
Options.Description: Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.

Options.Name: isFavorite
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.

Options.Name: mediaTypes
Options.Description: Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: imageTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: sortBy
Options.Description: Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.

Options.Name: isPlayed
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are played, or not.

Options.Name: genres
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: officialRatings
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: tags
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: years
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: enableUserData
Options.Description: Optional, include user data.

Options.Name: imageTypeLimit
Options.Description: Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.

Options.Name: enableImageTypes
Options.Description: Optional. The image types to include in the output.

Options.Name: person
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.

Options.Name: personIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.

Options.Name: personTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.

Options.Name: studios
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: artists
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: excludeArtistIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: artistIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.

Options.Name: albumArtistIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.

Options.Name: contributingArtistIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.

Options.Name: albums
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: albumIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: ids
Options.Description: Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: videoTypes
Options.Description: Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: minOfficialRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).

Options.Name: isLocked
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are locked.

Options.Name: isPlaceHolder
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are placeholders.

Options.Name: hasOfficialRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that have official ratings.

Options.Name: collapseBoxSetItems
Options.Description: Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.

Options.Name: minWidth
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.

Options.Name: minHeight
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.

Options.Name: maxWidth
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.

Options.Name: maxHeight
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.

Options.Name: is3D
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.

Options.Name: seriesStatus
Options.Description: Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: nameStartsWithOrGreater
Options.Description: Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.

Options.Name: nameStartsWith
Options.Description: Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.

Options.Name: nameLessThan
Options.Description: Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.

Options.Name: studioIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: genreIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: audioLanguages
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on audio language. This allows multiple, comma delimited values.

Options.Name: subtitleLanguages
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on subtitale language. This allows multiple, comma delimited values.

Options.Name: enableTotalRecordCount
Options.Description: Optional. Enable the total record count.

Options.Name: enableImages
Options.Description: Optional, include image information in output.
